memories.text:
- Chronic kidney disease
  - Status: eGFR 55 mL/min/1.73m2, serum creatinine 1.6 mg/dL, urine ACR 120 mg/g, Hb 12.8 g/dL; asymptomatic.
  - Plan: Continue telmisartan 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD, furosemide 20 mg OD, sodium bicarbonate 500 mg BD; monitor labs in 3 months; advise low‑salt diet, avoid NSAIDs.
- Depression
  - Status: PHQ‑9 10 (mild), reports low mood, fatigue; sleep 5‑6 h.
  - Plan: Start sertraline 50 mg OD after breakfast; counsel on sleep hygiene; review PHQ‑9 in 4 weeks.
- Psoriasis
  - Status: Plaques on elbows and knees, PASI 6; topical clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD.
  - Plan: Add methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD; LFT, CBC, creatinine today; review in 6 weeks.
- Weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm male cutoff).
- Diet advice: Breakfast – whole grain toast with egg white, no added salt.
  Lunch – millet roti, dal, vegetable curry, limited oil.
  Dinner – grilled fish, salad, small portion rice.
- Due: Not applicable (no glucose‑lowering therapy).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
To: Dermatology, Sunrise Specialty Centre
Reason: Moderate‑severe psoriasis requiring systemic therapy.
Current meds: clobetasol 0.05% cream BD, calcipotriol ointment OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly.
Request: Baseline assessment, consider phototherapy or biologic if needed.
Please send report to Dr Karthik Hegde (D04).

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
Dermatology reply: Patient assessed, PASI 6, nail involvement mild.
Recommend continuing methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly with folic acid, add topical calcipotriol‑betamethasone combo.
Phototherapy offered; patient declined due to work schedule.
Return to routine follow‑up in 3 months.
-- Dr S. Rao, Dermatology.
